_readme: Every voice on /voices, in page order. Adding a voice = one entry here plus its sample file under public/audio/voices/. functions/voices/index.js renders the cards from this list, functions/voices/[id].js the profile pages, and functions/download/voice/[id].js redirects to each entry's download. id is lowercase letters, digits and dashes, and never guide/submit/release/thanks/contributors/account. status: live, or soon (listed with a placeholder, no sample or download yet). download: the zip on a GitHub release, or null for a voice that comes with the add-on. Optional: bio (profile page; blank lines split paragraphs), samples (profile page; defaults to sample), avatar, curseforge, owner (a contributor's account id), donated (true for a voice made from a recording lent on /voices/lend: its pages say "voice by <credit>"; publish with lore.donation publish, which makes the owner row). Copy rule: never say how a voice is made. packs (optional): a voice's extra downloads, each {id, name, addon, clips, coverage, download}: its lands packs (LoreForever_Voice_<voice>_Alliance/_Horde, the places and people of that faction's zones plus the contested ones) and a complete bundle; /download/voice/<pack id> serves them, and a site path is linked as it is. The included voice's lands packs come in the main zip, so it lists none of those. A pack in another language (LOR-177: LoreForever_Voice_<Default|Female>_<locale>, one per narrator and language) has its 'language'; status soon keeps a pack off every page (and its download a 404) until it's released. The answers packs (LOR-227: LoreForever_Voice_<Default|Female>_Answers_<Part>[_<locale>], every question and answer outside the narrator's core pack, in parts that each fit one download) are listed the same way, one per part and language; their clips count only themselves. Pack ids follow the same rules.

voices.name: Lore Forever male narrator
voices.coverage: selected zone, capital and dungeon stories, places and people, dungeon bosses and first answers (other entries stay available as text; quest dialogue is a separate optional download)
voices.tagline: Has narrated every capital in one sitting. Doesn't blink. Declined our offer of water.
voices.bio:
The voice that comes with Lore Forever, and the first one you hear in Stormwind.

Has narrated every capital in one sitting. Doesn't blink. Declined our offer of water, then a chair, then a lunch break. Knows the founding of Stormwind by heart and will tell you about it whether or not you asked.

Favourite zone: all of them, in alphabetical order. Hobbies: dramatic pauses, and saying "Thrall" exactly right every single time.

packs.name: Quest dialogue — character voices
packs.summary: Reads quest text in voices matched to the character's race.
packs.coverage: Reads selected quest dialogue for male human, dwarf, Forsaken and orc quest givers. Turn on Speak quest dialogue and Match the quest giver's voice in Options. Other lines use your narrator's recording where available, or stay as text. These are quest lines, separate from Lore Forever's stories and answers.

voices.tagline: Asked for the candles lit and every murloc removed from the building. Got the candles.
voices.bio:
The second house voice, and an optional download: pick her in Options once she's installed.

Asked for the candles lit and every murloc removed from the building. Got the candles. Rumoured to have read the whole of Durotar aloud to a very patient kodo, twice, because the kodo asked.

Takes her tea the way the lore takes its villains: dark, and with a long backstory.
